Here for our crab fix - because Jumbo just does it well. Pretty views of the pier and river.
Nov 2024 • Family
Jumbo just has the best fat and juicy Sri Lankan chilli crabs in Singapore... so we're here for our crab-fix again. Trying the Thai-style claypot rice vermicilli with crab this time and it was still as good. The Garoupa fish we ordered was so succulent and fresh. Our kids went crazy for the Mentaiko shrimps that they went for seconds. Mango Pomelo desserts made a sweet chill ending of the meal.

We loved the view of the main Saigon pier and river from our table, and also loved that they're not crowded at all on a weekend afternoon. They're probably more crowded at night since most prefer their sumptuous seafood meals in the evenings!

Not worth it
Dec 2023 • Couples
My wife and I had dinner there. After a considerable waiting time we ordered our dishes - Japanese style scallops and noodles with Seafood. 
We were advised to take the small portion, it would be easily enough for us. 
The Japanese Scallops were bland. The vegetables seemed entirely unseasoned, same as the scallops. For this price, the dish was not balanced/sophisticated enough. 
The noodles were good & tasty. Both portions were too small for the price. And way too small for normal hungry customers. 
After again waiting for the check for quite some time, we paid and left with half empty stomachs. 
For this price, the food and service were not sufficient. 
Maybe the experience is different if you order the crabs. But for the food choices we made, we were disappointed.

Thank you for opening here... we've missed good chilli crab! Cheese was awesome too.
Dec 2021
We've tried some other Singaporean chilli crabs in Saigon, and finally decided to try Jumbo's when we were doing our staycay opposite the restaurant.

Main reasons why they won our hearts (and bellies!):

- the sauce is definitely much more flavorful, intense, and less starchy than others. Once you started having it, you find it hard to stop. We ordered takeaway and they were generous to give one big delicious piping hot bowl of it!

- ordered cheese crab for the kids, and they almost licked the entire bowl clean with their bread

- their crabs were truly fresh, bouncy and juicy... and even though they cost a whole lot more than other restaurants, but the quality of their crab was far more superior. Additionally, the taste of their chilli sauce had truly penetrated each and every part of the crab, unlike other places where it felt like the chilli sauce was just a "pour over", like a lazy afterthought

- we got the promotional deal of getting a serving of free cereal prawns with an order of any two crabs - and though free - the cereal prawns were packed with a full punch of the right Singaporean flavours... and similarly, a generous serving of those incredibly addictive cereals that went along so well with the crispy yet amazingly juicy prawns.

Hope they keep it up!

EspeciallyFor Crab Lovers
Mar 2020
If you are in Ho Chi Minh and crave for Singapore cooked style crabs head to Jumbo Seafood.This is a very popular restaurant for locals as well as expatriates.So reservations recommended on weekends. As we were a party of 8,we ordered the signature crab dishes...chilli crab,pepper crab and salted egg crab.We were not disappointed with the crab dishes.The crabs were fresh and yummy tasted like served in the Jumbo Seafood restaurant in Singapore. Other recommended dishes include fried rice with chicken and salted fish,"Kang Kong" with blachan and fried hor fun with seafood. Service by staff was excellent. Although the total bill was expensive compared to similar class seafood restaurants in the city,it was acceptable as we enjoyed a satisfying meal
